items.summary: Approve only bounded read-only security evidence capture, existing failed-run repair or closure, and continuation of deployed measurement gates. Reject third-party prototypes, revenue or ROI claims, new spend, monetization changes, public launch, and the proposed queue change because attribution is aggregate/unavailable, telemetry is low-volume or incomplete, outcomes are unproven, and the change lacks a measurable production outcome. Keep SearchWoot private; no research request is necessary because the relevant evidence gaps are already covered by existing internal workstreams.
